::: {.callout-note}
## Practice before building your roadmap

1. Move the sample experiments across the board and notice what evidence is needed at each stage.
2. Use the hypothesis guide to turn a process gap into a measurable prediction.
3. Compare effort and impact before deciding which experiment to run first.
4. When you are ready, [launch the interactive workspace](./kaizen-primary.qmd) with your own `gap-analysis.csv`.
:::

## 1. Explore a sample Kanban board

Each card represents a small test, not a permanent implementation. Select **Advance** to move work through the same stages used in the main workspace. A card should enter verification only when the team is ready to collect its success metric.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof kaizen_example_board = {
  const kaizen_example_statuses = [
    "Backlog / Proposed",
    "In Progress",
    "Testing / Verification",
    "Completed"
  ];
  const kaizen_example_initial_experiments = [
    {
      title: "5S Workplace Setup",
      target: "Reduce time spent locating shared sampling gear",
      hypothesis: "If the team labels and shadows the gear station, retrieval time will fall from 12 to 5 minutes within two weeks.",
      metric: "Median retrieval time ≤ 5 minutes",
      status: "Backlog / Proposed"
    },
    {
      title: "Automated Code Linting Gate",
      target: "Reduce formatting defects found during review",
      hypothesis: "If lint checks run before merge, formatting defects will fall from 8 to 2 per release during the next four releases.",
      metric: "≤ 2 formatting defects per release",
      status: "In Progress"
    },
    {
      title: "Single-Piece Flow Trial",
      target: "Reduce sample-processing lead time",
      hypothesis: "If samples move one at a time through intake and validation, median lead time will fall from 3 days to 1 day during a 20-sample pilot.",
      metric: "Median lead time ≤ 1 day",
      status: "Testing / Verification"
    }
  ];
  let kaizen_example_experiments = kaizen_example_initial_experiments.map(
    kaizen_example_experiment => ({...kaizen_example_experiment})
  );

  const kaizen_example_root = document.createElement("div");
  kaizen_example_root.className = "kaizen-example-panel";
  const kaizen_example_controls = document.createElement("div");
  kaizen_example_controls.className = "kaizen-example-controls";
  const kaizen_example_reset = document.createElement("button");
  kaizen_example_reset.type = "button";
  kaizen_example_reset.textContent = "Reset sample board";
  const kaizen_example_status = document.createElement("span");
  kaizen_example_status.setAttribute("role", "status");
  kaizen_example_status.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  kaizen_example_controls.append(kaizen_example_reset, kaizen_example_status);
  const kaizen_example_board_element = document.createElement("div");
  kaizen_example_board_element.className = "kaizen-example-board";
  kaizen_example_root.append(
    kaizen_example_controls,
    kaizen_example_board_element
  );

  function kaizen_example_render_board() {
    kaizen_example_board_element.replaceChildren();
    for (const kaizen_example_column_status of kaizen_example_statuses) {
      const kaizen_example_column = document.createElement("section");
      kaizen_example_column.className = "kaizen-example-column";
      const kaizen_example_heading = document.createElement("h3");
      const kaizen_example_cards = kaizen_example_experiments.filter(
        kaizen_example_experiment =>
          kaizen_example_experiment.status === kaizen_example_column_status
      );
      kaizen_example_heading.textContent =
        `${kaizen_example_column_status} (${kaizen_example_cards.length})`;
      kaizen_example_column.append(kaizen_example_heading);

      for (const kaizen_example_experiment of kaizen_example_cards) {
        const kaizen_example_card = document.createElement("article");
        kaizen_example_card.className = "kaizen-example-card";
        const kaizen_example_title = document.createElement("strong");
        kaizen_example_title.textContent = kaizen_example_experiment.title;
        const kaizen_example_target = document.createElement("p");
        kaizen_example_target.textContent =
          `Target gap: ${kaizen_example_experiment.target}`;
        const kaizen_example_hypothesis = document.createElement("p");
        kaizen_example_hypothesis.textContent =
          `Hypothesis: ${kaizen_example_experiment.hypothesis}`;
        const kaizen_example_metric = document.createElement("p");
        kaizen_example_metric.textContent =
          `Success: ${kaizen_example_experiment.metric}`;
        kaizen_example_card.append(
          kaizen_example_title,
          kaizen_example_target,
          kaizen_example_hypothesis,
          kaizen_example_metric
        );

        const kaizen_example_index = kaizen_example_statuses.indexOf(
          kaizen_example_experiment.status
        );
        if (kaizen_example_index < kaizen_example_statuses.length - 1) {
          const kaizen_example_advance = document.createElement("button");
          kaizen_example_advance.type = "button";
          kaizen_example_advance.textContent = "Advance →";
          kaizen_example_advance.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            `Advance ${kaizen_example_experiment.title}`
          );
          kaizen_example_advance.addEventListener("click", () => {
            kaizen_example_experiment.status =
              kaizen_example_statuses[kaizen_example_index + 1];
            kaizen_example_status.textContent =
              `${kaizen_example_experiment.title} moved to ${kaizen_example_experiment.status}.`;
            kaizen_example_render_board();
          });
          kaizen_example_card.append(kaizen_example_advance);
        }
        kaizen_example_column.append(kaizen_example_card);
      }
      kaizen_example_board_element.append(kaizen_example_column);
    }
  }

  kaizen_example_reset.addEventListener("click", () => {
    kaizen_example_experiments = kaizen_example_initial_experiments.map(
      kaizen_example_experiment => ({...kaizen_example_experiment})
    );
    kaizen_example_status.textContent = "The sample board was reset.";
    kaizen_example_render_board();
  });
  kaizen_example_render_board();
  kaizen_example_root
}
```

## 2. Build a measurable hypothesis

A useful hypothesis connects one deliberate change to one expected result, with a baseline, target, and test period. Adjust the fields below to see that structure assembled.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof kaizen_example_hypothesis_guide = {
  const kaizen_example_guide_root = document.createElement("div");
  kaizen_example_guide_root.className =
    "kaizen-example-panel kaizen-example-stack";
  const kaizen_example_guide_form = document.createElement("div");
  kaizen_example_guide_form.className = "kaizen-example-form";

  function kaizen_example_make_field(
    kaizen_example_id,
    kaizen_example_label_text,
    kaizen_example_value,
    kaizen_example_type = "text"
  ) {
    const kaizen_example_label = document.createElement("label");
    kaizen_example_label.htmlFor = kaizen_example_id;
    kaizen_example_label.textContent = kaizen_example_label_text;
    const kaizen_example_input = document.createElement("input");
    kaizen_example_input.id = kaizen_example_id;
    kaizen_example_input.type = kaizen_example_type;
    kaizen_example_input.value = kaizen_example_value;
    kaizen_example_label.append(kaizen_example_input);
    kaizen_example_guide_form.append(kaizen_example_label);
    return kaizen_example_input;
  }

  const kaizen_example_gap = kaizen_example_make_field(
    "kaizen-example-gap",
    "Observed gap",
    "formatting defects are found during review"
  );
  const kaizen_example_change = kaizen_example_make_field(
    "kaizen-example-change",
    "Change to test",
    "run automated lint checks before merge"
  );
  const kaizen_example_metric_input = kaizen_example_make_field(
    "kaizen-example-metric",
    "Metric",
    "formatting defects per release"
  );
  const kaizen_example_baseline = kaizen_example_make_field(
    "kaizen-example-baseline",
    "Baseline",
    "8"
  );
  const kaizen_example_target_input = kaizen_example_make_field(
    "kaizen-example-target",
    "Target",
    "2"
  );
  const kaizen_example_period = kaizen_example_make_field(
    "kaizen-example-period",
    "Test period or sample",
    "the next four releases"
  );

  const kaizen_example_hypothesis_result = document.createElement("p");
  kaizen_example_hypothesis_result.className =
    "kaizen-example-result kaizen-example-wide";
  kaizen_example_hypothesis_result.setAttribute("role", "status");
  kaizen_example_hypothesis_result.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  const kaizen_example_guide_checklist = document.createElement("ul");
  kaizen_example_guide_checklist.className =
    "kaizen-example-checklist kaizen-example-wide";
  kaizen_example_guide_form.append(
    kaizen_example_hypothesis_result,
    kaizen_example_guide_checklist
  );
  kaizen_example_guide_root.append(kaizen_example_guide_form);

  function kaizen_example_render_hypothesis() {
    kaizen_example_hypothesis_result.textContent =
      `If we ${kaizen_example_change.value.trim()}, then ` +
      `${kaizen_example_metric_input.value.trim()} will change from ` +
      `${kaizen_example_baseline.value.trim()} to ` +
      `${kaizen_example_target_input.value.trim()} during ` +
      `${kaizen_example_period.value.trim()}.`;
    const kaizen_example_checks = [
      ["Names the process problem", kaizen_example_gap.value.trim()],
      ["Tests one specific change", kaizen_example_change.value.trim()],
      [
        "Includes a measurable baseline and target",
        kaizen_example_metric_input.value.trim() &&
          kaizen_example_baseline.value.trim() &&
          kaizen_example_target_input.value.trim()
      ],
      ["Defines a test boundary", kaizen_example_period.value.trim()]
    ];
    kaizen_example_guide_checklist.replaceChildren();
    for (const [kaizen_example_check, kaizen_example_complete] of
      kaizen_example_checks) {
      const kaizen_example_item = document.createElement("li");
      kaizen_example_item.textContent =
        `${kaizen_example_complete ? "✓" : "○"} ${kaizen_example_check}`;
      kaizen_example_guide_checklist.append(kaizen_example_item);
    }
  }

  for (const kaizen_example_input of [
    kaizen_example_gap,
    kaizen_example_change,
    kaizen_example_metric_input,
    kaizen_example_baseline,
    kaizen_example_target_input,
    kaizen_example_period
  ]) {
    kaizen_example_input.addEventListener(
      "input",
      kaizen_example_render_hypothesis
    );
  }
  kaizen_example_render_hypothesis();
  kaizen_example_guide_root
}
```

The observed gap explains *why* the experiment matters. The hypothesis itself must remain falsifiable: if the result misses the target, record what happened rather than rewriting the prediction.

## 3. Prioritize by effort and impact

Start with high-impact, low-effort experiments when they are safe and their success measures are trustworthy. High-impact, high-effort ideas need planning; low-impact, high-effort ideas should usually wait. Select an experiment in the matrix to review its ranking.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof kaizen_example_priority_matrix = {
  const kaizen_example_priority_items = [
    {
      title: "5S Workplace Setup",
      effort: "Low",
      impact: "High",
      reason: "Run first: the test is contained and can quickly reduce retrieval delay."
    },
    {
      title: "Automated Code Linting Gate",
      effort: "High",
      impact: "High",
      reason: "Plan carefully: the potential impact is high, but pipeline setup and team adoption require coordination."
    },
    {
      title: "Single-Piece Flow Trial",
      effort: "Low",
      impact: "Low",
      reason: "Consider later: the pilot is easy to run, but its expected reach is limited."
    },
    {
      title: "Replace All Lab Equipment",
      effort: "High",
      impact: "Low",
      reason: "Avoid for now: the expected benefit does not justify the cost and disruption."
    }
  ];
  const kaizen_example_quadrants = [
    ["High", "Low", "first", "Run first"],
    ["High", "High", "plan", "Plan"],
    ["Low", "Low", "later", "Consider later"],
    ["Low", "High", "avoid", "Avoid"]
  ];
  const kaizen_example_matrix_root = document.createElement("div");
  kaizen_example_matrix_root.className = "kaizen-example-panel";
  const kaizen_example_matrix = document.createElement("div");
  kaizen_example_matrix.className = "kaizen-example-matrix";
  const kaizen_example_blank = document.createElement("span");
  const kaizen_example_low_effort = document.createElement("strong");
  kaizen_example_low_effort.className = "kaizen-example-axis";
  kaizen_example_low_effort.textContent = "Low effort";
  const kaizen_example_high_effort = document.createElement("strong");
  kaizen_example_high_effort.className = "kaizen-example-axis";
  kaizen_example_high_effort.textContent = "High effort";
  kaizen_example_matrix.append(
    kaizen_example_blank,
    kaizen_example_low_effort,
    kaizen_example_high_effort
  );

  const kaizen_example_high_impact = document.createElement("strong");
  kaizen_example_high_impact.className =
    "kaizen-example-axis kaizen-example-axis-vertical";
  kaizen_example_high_impact.textContent = "High impact";
  kaizen_example_matrix.append(kaizen_example_high_impact);

  const kaizen_example_detail = document.createElement("p");
  kaizen_example_detail.className = "kaizen-example-priority-detail";
  kaizen_example_detail.setAttribute("role", "status");
  kaizen_example_detail.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");

  function kaizen_example_add_quadrant(
    kaizen_example_impact,
    kaizen_example_effort,
    kaizen_example_rank,
    kaizen_example_heading_text
  ) {
    const kaizen_example_quadrant = document.createElement("section");
    kaizen_example_quadrant.className = "kaizen-example-quadrant";
    kaizen_example_quadrant.dataset.rank = kaizen_example_rank;
    const kaizen_example_heading = document.createElement("strong");
    kaizen_example_heading.textContent = kaizen_example_heading_text;
    kaizen_example_quadrant.append(kaizen_example_heading);
    for (const kaizen_example_item of kaizen_example_priority_items.filter(
      kaizen_example_candidate =>
        kaizen_example_candidate.impact === kaizen_example_impact &&
        kaizen_example_candidate.effort === kaizen_example_effort
    )) {
      const kaizen_example_button = document.createElement("button");
      kaizen_example_button.type = "button";
      kaizen_example_button.textContent = kaizen_example_item.title;
      kaizen_example_button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        kaizen_example_detail.textContent =
          `${kaizen_example_item.title} — ${kaizen_example_item.reason}`;
      });
      kaizen_example_quadrant.append(kaizen_example_button);
    }
    kaizen_example_matrix.append(kaizen_example_quadrant);
  }

  kaizen_example_add_quadrant(...kaizen_example_quadrants[0]);
  kaizen_example_add_quadrant(...kaizen_example_quadrants[1]);
  const kaizen_example_low_impact = document.createElement("strong");
  kaizen_example_low_impact.className =
    "kaizen-example-axis kaizen-example-axis-vertical";
  kaizen_example_low_impact.textContent = "Low impact";
  kaizen_example_matrix.append(kaizen_example_low_impact);
  kaizen_example_add_quadrant(...kaizen_example_quadrants[2]);
  kaizen_example_add_quadrant(...kaizen_example_quadrants[3]);
  kaizen_example_detail.textContent =
    "Select an experiment to see why it belongs in that quadrant.";
  kaizen_example_matrix_root.append(
    kaizen_example_matrix,
    kaizen_example_detail
  );
  kaizen_example_matrix_root
}
```

Effort and impact are relative estimates, not precise scores. Confirm them with the people doing the work, consider safety and dependencies, and revisit the ranking as evidence changes.
